# Olabisi Adigun

> Olabisi Adigun is a designer, full-stack engineer and product builder based in
> Ilorin, Nigeria. The site is a portfolio of shipped products, case studies,
> client work and writing, focused on Fintech, EdTech and applied AI, with an
> emphasis on secure, offline-first systems.

This file helps LLMs and agents summarise and cite this site accurately.

## About
- Name: Olabisi Adigun
- Role: Designer, Full-stack Engineer, Product Builder
- Location: Ilorin, Nigeria (WAT, UTC+1)
- Contact: abeladigun11@gmail.com
- Highlight: Hackathon winner, Build with Gemma (Google DeepMind), 2026

## Key pages
- [Home](https://olabisiadigun.xyz/): portfolio overview, selected work, services, writing.
- [About](https://olabisiadigun.xyz/about/): career story and capabilities.
- [Services](https://olabisiadigun.xyz/services/): product design, web development, AI product engineering, brand identity.

## Selected work
- [Sentry](https://olabisiadigun.xyz/works/sentry/): AI community-safety platform; Build with Gemma winner.
- [Pulse](https://olabisiadigun.xyz/works/pulse/): offline payment protocol case study (concept, not deployed).
- [MeshLearn](https://olabisiadigun.xyz/works/meshlearn/): offline learning network over BLE mesh.
- [S.A.F.E.](https://olabisiadigun.xyz/works/safe/): campus emergency reporting system for KWASU.
- [STRĪKE](https://olabisiadigun.xyz/works/strike/): premium streetwear e-commerce front end.
